3. Form 1 under the “Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme” is now available for filing.
4. ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3, ITR-4, ITR-5, ITR-6 and ITR-7 for AY 2026-27 are available for filing through both online and offline utilities.
5. Filing of TDS/TCS Correction Statements pertaining to Tax Year 2026-27 has been enabled.

6. Demand Management Facilitation Centre (DFC), has been set up to guide Taxpayers on issues/grievances regarding their outstanding demands. DFC may be contacted through the e-mail id: taxdemand@cpc.incometax.gov.in or on the toll-free number - 1800 309 0131 or chargeable no. 0821-6671200.
7. Excel utilities for filing Updated return for ITR-1 to 7 for AY 2022-23 as per Finance Act, 2026 are available for filing !

A  was introduced under the Companies Act, 2013, to enable a single individual to operate a company with limited liability and a separate legal identity. It provides an alternative to a sole proprietorship for entrepreneurs seeking a formal corporate structure with comparatively simpler compliance.
An OPC can be incorporated and managed by a single member.
The member’s liability is generally limited to the extent of their shareholding, subject to applicable law.
The OPC has a legal identity separate from its member.
A nominee is appointed to take over membership in the event of the member’s death.
OPCs generally have fewer compliance requirements than private limited companies.
Only one individual can incorporate an OPC.
The member must satisfy the applicable citizenship and residency requirements under Indian company law.
A nominee must be appointed as prescribed under the Companies Act.
An OPC cannot be incorporated for certain restricted activities, including specified financial activities.
Mandatory conversion requirements depend on the applicable provisions of the Companies Act and should be assessed based on the company’s circumstances.
PAN and identity proof of the proposed member
Rent agreement and NOC, where applicable
Other incorporation documents as prescribed by the MCA
The proposed member and relevant signatories require a DSC for electronic filing.
The Director Identification Number (DIN) is allotted through the applicable incorporation process for the proposed director.
Apply for name reservation through the applicable MCA process. The proposed name must comply with prescribed naming rules and include the required OPC designation.

Enables one individual to operate a formal corporate entity.
Provides protection against business liabilities, subject to applicable law.
Enhances business credibility and enables the company to own assets and enter contracts in its own name.
Generally involves fewer compliance requirements than a private limited company.
Nominee provisions help ensure continuity in the event of the member’s death.
